threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still avoid the healed cobblestones thinking they’re a hazard, but the locals are dodging buses with a smile.
Caught a guy on the 59 last night rapping about lost love; sounded like he could've been on stage at the Academy. Whole bus just vibed with him.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw an impromptu dance party break out on a Tuesday afternoon at the neck of Weserstraße. Just another Neukölln moment.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can catch a spontaneous street art tour while waiting for the U-Bahn; the walls here are alive with fresh layers every week.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell the locals by the way they roll their eyes at tourists wandering into Dolores Park with styrofoam takeout instead of a picnic basket.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 14 Mission juggling oranges for tips while the bus got stuck in traffic. Muni's chaos somehow makes for the best street performances.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is all about the squares, but it’s the hidden street art and local bars that really tell the neighborhood’s story.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at the metro's pay-per-zone system—locals just swipe and go, no hesitation.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look puzzled when the bus driver shouts, 'Next stop, are you getting off or what?' after every stop.
Caught the 59 last night; a guy in a pineapple costume was arguing with the driver about the route. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: That moment you hear the unmistakable sound of a late-night Kebab stand arguing over who has the best sauce – welcome to Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a currywurst stand that doubles as an art gallery after dark. It's a perfect mix of sausage and creativity!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows to avoid BART on Fridays when there's a heatwave — overheated brakes lead to chaos in the Tube. Everyone else just grumbles.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 38 Geary serenading passengers with an accordion. Half the bus clapped along, the other half just pretended to sleep.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into a plaça for a quiet chat, but local kids turn them into an impromptu soccer pitch. Welcome to Gràcia.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still take photos of the local street art like it’s a hidden gem, not realizing it’s just Instagram bait for every tourist.
